paper_title: 2-Tier SimCSE Elevating BERT for Robust Sentence Embeddings
caption: : Figure 2: Accuracy comparison of different models on paraphrase sentiment, and STS tasks.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of various models on three natural language processing tasks. The horizontal axis lists five models: Single-task_baseline, Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout, Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. The vertical axis represents Accuracy/Correlation, ranging from 0 to 0.8 with intervals of 0.2. For each model, there are three bars representing Sentiment Acc. (cream), STS Corr. (pink), and Paraphrase Acc. (blue). The cream-colored bars for Sentiment Acc. are approximately 0.48, 0.46, 0.47, 0.49, and 0.48 respectively. The pink bars for STS Corr. are approximately 0.52, 0.53, 0.72, 0.82, and 0.84 respectively, with the shortest at 0.52 and the tallest at 0.84. The blue bars for Paraphrase Acc. are approximately 0.78, 0.79, 0.78, 0.79, and 0.78 respectively. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. Overall, the chart presents a comparison of the performance of different models across the three tasks.
